series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction and moderate seasonality with high noise levels. Unstable rankings and moderate RMSE spread suggest a weighted combination approach using inverse RMSE weights to leverage model diversity while avoiding single-model selection due to ranking instability.

reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rmse_spread_ratio=0.2979 AND series_profile.combination_recommendation.strategy_type=weighted → inverse RMSE weighting leverages model performance differences while applying shrinkage (0.35) to avoid overfitting with few windows (n_windows=2)
reasoning.topk_mean_per_horizon_k4: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → per-horizon top-k averaging captures differentiated model performance across forecast horizons
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → per-horizon selection exploits consistent winners at different horizons

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high AND n_windows=2 → ridge stacking overfits with few windows
